final: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, o.lunarstage, t.bandusagepct FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), station_avgs AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM matched GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation), phase_avgs AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandusage FROM station_avgs GROUP BY lunarstage), phase_counts AS (SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM matched GROUP BY lunarstage), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM matched) SELECT c.lunarstage, a.avg_bandusage, c.telescope_count, 1.0 * c.telescope_count / t.total_count AS fraction_of_total FROM phase_counts AS c JOIN phase_avgs AS a ON (a.lunarstage = c.lunarstage OR (a.lunarstage IS NULL AND c.lunarstage IS NULL)) CROSS JOIN total AS t
